ADM.why: Headlines are mostly sector comparisons and Jim Cramer commentary favoring ADM. No news about Section 45Z changes, biofuel policy alterations, or RVO mandate threats. The positive Cramer mention actually supports the thesis. No exit condition triggered.

ALL.why: Hurricane Isaias headline is relevant to catastrophe risk monitoring. While the headline doesn't specify ALL losses or indicate they exceed $2.5B in a single quarter, hurricane season creates elevated tail risk for the insurer. Requires monitoring of actual catastrophe loss disclosures, but not yet a definitive break of the exit condition.

DLTR.why: Recent tariff refund headline shows a $383M one-time benefit that actually supported earnings beats, not a cut. Upcoming Q3 guidance is the key test for the exit condition ($0.80 EPS threshold), but no new Q3 guidance cut has been announced. Operational challenges mentioned are pre-existing thesis considerations. No exit condition triggered yet.

DXCM.why: Citi reiterates DXCM as a top medtech pick, reinforcing the bullish revision trend and sector tailwind. Senseonics headline about a competitor is not materially relevant to DXCM's thesis. No guidance cut below 20% operating margin or credit facility refinancing difficulty disclosed. Thesis remains supported.

KMX.why: Multiple headlines highlight KMX margin pressures and rising credit exposure following Q2 earnings. While the headlines don't specify a unit margin decline exceeding $200/unit guidance for FY2027, the persistent focus on 'margin pressures' warrants close monitoring of guidance and management commentary ahead of future earnings. Competitor CVNA's declining per-vehicle profit also signals sector-wide margin stress.

RS.why: Headlines focus on competitor investments (PPG, APD) and unrelated retail news (7-Eleven). No direct news about Reliance's Metals Service Centers revenue or Q3 performance. Valuation commentary ('fully priced') is not an exit trigger. October 21 earnings report remains the key test for the exit condition, which has not yet occurred.
